April 30, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
David Einhorn increased its stake in General Mtrs Co (GM) by 1193.11% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Greenlight Capital Inc bought 23.86M shares as the company’s stock declined 17.02% with the market. The hedge fund run by David Einhorn held 25.86 million shares of the auto manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.06 billion, up from 2.00M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Greenlight Capital Inc who had been investing in General Mtrs Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $53.34B market cap company. The stock increased 0.52% or $0.19 $37.85. About 2.08 million shares traded. General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) has risen 0.46% uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.09% the S&P500.
Warren Buffett decreased its stake in Sanofi (SNY) by 0.7% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Berkshire Hathaway Inc sold 27,351 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.41% with the market. The hedge fund run by Warren Buffett held 3.88M shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $166.78 million, down from 3.91M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Berkshire Hathaway Inc who had been investing in Sanofi for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $99.09 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.53% or $0.21 $39.81. About 277,157 shares traded. Sanofi (NYSE:SNY) has declined 13.31% downtrending. It has underperformed by 24.86% the S&P500.
Greenlight Capital Inc, which manages about $11.41B and $5.50 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Aercap Holdings Nv (NYSE:AER) by 2.59M shares to 9.77M shares, valued at $513.90M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Dillards Inc (NYSE:DDS) by 694,341 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 805,659 shares, and cut its stake in Varex Imaging Corp.
